A '''centennial feast''' celebrating the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Bakuush]] was held in [[Bakuush's palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] sometime before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], and [[orpali dragon]]s were among the delicacies on the menu. However, several dragon hatchlings escaped into the palace's sewers and made their way to the planet's [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]], where they eventually evolved into the [[Species/Legends|species]] known as [[chemilizard]]s.<ref name="Chemilizard" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bakuush's centennial feast was first mentioned in the Codex entry for chemilizard in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Chemilizard" />
